title: Trump defers to appeals court over army plan to detonate bomb-making material in Iowa
summary_full: Environmentalists sued last week to stop detonation of 68 barrels of lead azide over health and pollution concerns Donald Trump on Monday said he would defer to a federal appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.Nearly 400 people live in Middletown, where the plant is sited, and thousands more in surrounding areas could be affected by detonated material that could disperse in the air and land on the ground.
